title: Refactor Monolithic Request Dispatcher to Pluggable Handler Strategy
description: In the routing module (src/dispatcher.py), the `RequestDispatcher` currently uses an inflexible, monolithic `if/elif/else` chain inside `dispatch(request)`. Refactor `RequestDispatcher` to follow the Strategy/Registry pattern: define an abstract base class `BaseRequestHandler` with `can_handle(request: Request) -> bool` and `handle(request: Request) -> Response`, support registering new handlers via `register_handler(handler: BaseRequestHandler)`, and provide standard handlers for 'json', 'xml', and 'form'. Maintain 100% backward compatibility for all existing `dispatch()` calls and raise `UnsupportedContentTypeError` for unknown types.
